claims.finding: Three new hot cores N3, N4, N5 discovered

evidence.quote: We report the discovery of three new hot cores in Sgr B2(N) that we call Sgr B2(N3), Sgr B2(N4), and Sgr B2(N5).

claims.hypothesis: Do N3 and N5 drive outflows?
claims.experiment: Integrated line wing maps of SO, OCS, CS

evidence.quote: Sgr B2(N3) and Sgr B2(N5) show high velocity wing emission in typical outflow tracers
